PDF417 codeword table (barcode_pdf417_tables.go)
================================================

The table mapping each PDF417 codeword to its 17-module bar/space pattern
(3 clusters x 929 codewords) is defined by ISO/IEC 15438:2001 Annex A. The
copy in barcode_pdf417_tables.go was extracted mechanically (tools/genpdf417)
from the table in ZXing's PDF417.java
(core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/encoder/PDF417.java), whose header
reads:

    Copyright 2006 Jeremias Maerki in part, and ZXing Authors in part

    Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
    ...

    This file has been modified from its original form in Barcode4J.

That is, the table originates in Jeremias Maerki's Barcode4J and was carried
into ZXing. It was then verified against the independently developed copy in
zint (libzint, backend/pdf417_tabs.h; Copyright Robin Stuart): all 2,787
entries are identical.

The full text of the Apache License, Version 2.0, is in APACHE-2.0.txt in this
directory. No other ZXing, Barcode4J or zint code is included in this library.
